criteria.name: A3-1  the closed channel reproduces A2 bitwise
criteria.detail: largest absolute difference over 2 seeds and four series: 0.000e+00. Not a tolerance: anything but zero is a different model

criteria.name: A3-2  a gap opens between agents who started level
criteria.detail: entry pair, 5 either side of the allocation boundary: mean net worth ratio 62.5 against a floor of 2.0. A floor, not a finding: this is owning against not owning and is not evidence for A3-4

criteria.name: A3-3  the gap compounds rather than levelling off
criteria.detail: largest drift between a node's first and second half of trades, over 9 nodes with four or more: 4.27e-16. Constant in logs is geometric in levels, so the gap after N round trips is the holonomy to the Nth power

criteria.name: A3-4  the realised terms differential is the loop sum
criteria.detail: mean cell-adjusted return, better group minus worse: +0.38166 against a holonomy of +0.39724 from the product graph, relative error 3.92% against 20%. Price cancellation observed, not assumed: largest holonomy shift under unrelated prices 5.55e-16

criteria.name: A3-5  the gate binds at the high tier, not at ownership
criteria.detail: price frozen, so opening a tier is a gate change and nothing else: low 796.53, high 3.03, against 1.5. With the price free to respond: low 2.71, high 2.69 -- admitting everyone to a tier also puts their claims into that tier's bidder pool, so the price runs and the incumbents, who hold most of the units, gain most

criteria.name: A3-6  the stock survives a generation
criteria.detail: survival of the shock's net worth deviation after 40 rounds: 0.0% into the median node, 30.5% into the richest, against 50% required and 0.00% on the A2 carrier. The criterion does not name the recipient and the two answers disagree; the median is reported as the verdict because it is the harder one. A stock exists for whoever can buy the asset and for nobody else, so A4 is unblocked only for that part of the population

criteria.name: A3-7  non-overlapping windows agree in sign
criteria.detail: better terms beat worse in [0,100): 100%, [100,200): 50%, [200,300): 0% of seeds. One window only would be a repricing
